title: Foxn3 is part of a transcriptional network that regulates primary cilia in the developing retina.
authors: Zhang, Huanqing; Nair, Thejas; Meng, Fan; Turner, David L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Foxn3与Rfx3在视网膜发育中调控纤毛基因的转录网络，包含TF-DNA结合（CUT&RUN）和AlphaFold 3预测蛋白互作，但核心是转录调控而非TF-DNA结合位点建模，方法上仅用结构预测，缺乏AI/物理模拟深度，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Retinas from mice with a targeted disruption of the gene encoding forkhead transcription factor Foxn3 contained additional displaced amacrine interneurons and retinal astrocytes in the inner plexiform and ganglion cell layers, as well as ectopic primary cilia on bipolar and amacrine interneurons. Foxn3 is a transcriptional repressor and numerous genes linked to cilia structure or assembly were upregulated in embryonic retinas with disrupted Foxn3. CUT&RUN analysis revealed that many upregulated retinal genes were bound by the Foxn3 and Rfx3 proteins. A short hydrophobic motif (LXXLXWL) shared by Foxn3, Foxn4 and Foxj1 was required for association with Rfx3 and for full transcriptional repression by Foxn3, as well as for full transcriptional activation by Foxj1 or Foxn4. AlphaFold 3 predicted interaction between the hydrophobic motif and the Rfx3 dimerization domain. Mutations in Rfx3 at the predicted interaction site disrupted association of Rfx3 with Foxn3, Foxn4 or Foxj1. These results reveal a new layer of transcriptional regulation of genes required for cilia, with Foxn3 functioning as a repressor of cilia genes and limiting primary cilia formation in the developing retina.
abstract_zh: 靶向破坏编码叉头转录因子Foxn3基因的小鼠视网膜中，内丛状层和神经节细胞层含有额外的移位无长突中间神经元和视网膜星形胶质细胞，以及双极和無长突中间神经元上的异位初级纤毛。Foxn3是一种转录抑制因子，在Foxn3被破坏的胚胎视网膜中，许多与纤毛结构或组装相关的基因上调。CUT&RUN分析显示，许多上调的视网膜基因被Foxn3和Rfx3蛋白结合。Foxn3、Foxn4和Foxj1共有的一个短疏水基序（LXXLXWL）对于与Rfx3的关联、Foxn3的完全转录抑制以及Foxj1或Foxn4的完全转录激活均属必需。AlphaFold 3预测了该疏水基序与Rfx3二聚化结构域之间的相互作用。在预测的相互作用位点上的Rfx3突变破坏了Rfx3与Foxn3、Foxn4或Foxj1的关联。这些结果揭示了纤毛所需基因转录调控的一个新层面，其中Foxn3作为纤毛基因的抑制因子，限制发育中视网膜的初级纤毛形成。
